FreeAgent for free with Mettle, NatWest & RBS for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax

FreeAgent for free with Mettle, NatWest & RBS is on HMRC's list of software recognised for Making Tax Digital for Income Tax. HMRC lists it as software that creates digital records, for sole trader, UK property income. It can send your quarterly updates and submit your tax return.

  • HMRC says there is a free version. Check its limits on the provider site.
  • It is ready to report Construction Industry Scheme (CIS) deductions on your tax return.

Price

Free for eligible bank customers

Free while you keep a NatWest, Royal Bank of Scotland or Ulster Bank business current account, or a Mettle account with at least one transaction a month.

Checked 18 November 2026 on the provider's pricing page. Prices and offers change, so confirm before you buy.

What it can put on your tax return

HMRC lists 16 of 16 other income and tax-return items as ready now. "In development" means the provider has told HMRC it will build it in time for the 2026 to 2027 tax return.

Other details

Update periods: standard (6 April to 5 April) Yes; calendar (1 April to 31 March) Yes. For individuals: Yes. For agents: Yes. Accessibility features listed: Blindness or impaired vision, Deafness or impaired hearing, Motor or physical difficulties, Cognitive impairments. Language: English.
